evidence: Live model regeneration through the production decision API and worker, in an isolated Postgres schema; source pages replayed from saved Tally capture. No live crawl or real owner response.

question.question: Which starting path should this guide emphasize?
question.rationale: A general form-building focus keeps the first-form guide and templates first. An AI-first focus would lead with Tally AI, while a migration focus would lead with importing existing forms and cover that workflow more prominently.
